title: You, Like a Star
synopsis: Kai Aono is a high school student. He transfers to a scenic island in the Seto Inland Sea from Kyoto. There, he meets high school student Akimi Inoue, who was born on the island and lives with her mother. They fall in love with each other, but they are forced to make a choice due to their own fates.

synopsis_lang.en: Kai Aono is a high school student. He transfers to a scenic island in the Seto Inland Sea from Kyoto. There, he meets high school student Akimi Inoue, who was born on the island and lives with her mother. They fall in love with each other, but they are forced to make a choice due to their own fates.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 海天一色的小島上，從京都轉學而來的高中生櫂（橫濱流星 飾），邂逅了在島上長大、與母親相依為命的曉海（廣瀨鈴 飾）。同樣背負家庭帶來的缺憾，兩顆孤獨的心很快互相靠近，成為了彼此世上唯一的星辰。為了追逐夢想，櫂決定前往東京；而為了守護家人，曉海選擇留在島上工作。隨著歲月流轉，這對戀人無情地面臨無數個艱難抉擇。跨越十五年的深情愛戀，他們將如何面對人生的分岔路口？
